headline: Stonecradle and Fisherman's Row Flare as Frontline Shuffling Continues
war_summary: Stonecradle has reignited as a major flashpoint over the past two hours, logging five strategic base shifts around World's End and The Cord alongside nearly four hundred casualties. Fisherman's Row similarly escalated, recording five rapid base transitions across Eidolo and Black Well while leaving one strongpoint contested in no-man's-land. Fighting remains intensely volatile in Weathered Expanse, which added six fresh base actions and over fourteen hundred combined casualties in the two-hour window, focused on Frostmarch and Crow's Nest. Mooring County also resumed active base trading, posting three structural events near The Wind Hills and Wiccwalk under heavy casualty pressure. In Linn of Mercy, two fresh transitions occurred around Lathair as enlistment rates accelerated. Conversely, base turnover stalled across Stlican Shelf and Farranac Coast despite sustained skirmishing, while Callahan's Passage absorbed upwards of thirteen hundred casualties in two hours without immediate shifts in base ownership.
